import numpy as np

y = df['Salary_LPA']

plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))

plt.scatter(x, y, alpha=0.5)

# Trend line

p = np.poly1d(z)
plt.plot(df['Internships'], p(df['Internships']))

plt.title("Internships vs Salary (Improved)")
plt.xlabel("Number of Internships")
plt.ylabel("Salary (LPA)")

plt.grid(True)

plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Create CGPA bins (VERY IMPORTANT)
df['CGPA_Bin'] = pd.cut(df['CGPA'], bins=[5,6,7,8,9,10])

# Calculate average salary per bin
avg_salary = df.groupby('CGPA_Bin')['Salary_LPA'].mean()

# Count students per bin (optional second line)
count_students = df.groupby('CGPA_Bin')['Salary_LPA'].count()

# -------------------------------
# PLOT CLEAN CHART
# -------------------------------
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))

# Line 1 → Avg Salary
plt.plot(avg_salary.index.astype(str), avg_salary.values, marker='o', label='Avg Salary')

# Line 2 → Student Count (insightful)
plt.plot(count_students.index.astype(str), count_students.values, marker='s', linestyle='--', label='Student Count')

plt.title("CGPA vs Salary Trend (Binned Analysis)")
plt.xlabel("CGPA Range")
plt.ylabel("Values")
plt.legend()
plt.grid()

plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv(r"C:\Users\Vinay Kumar\Downloads\archive (3)\student_placement_career_success_dataset_2026.csv")

# -------------------------------
# CREATE FIGURE (DASHBOARD)
# -------------------------------
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16,10))
fig.suptitle(" Student Placement Dashboard", fontsize=20)

# -------------------------------
# 1. CGPA vs Salary (Scatter + Trend)
# -------------------------------
ax1 = plt.subplot(2,3,1)

x = df['CGPA']
y = df['Salary_LPA']

ax1.scatter(x, y, alpha=0.5)

# Trend line
z = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
p = np.poly1d(z)
ax1.plot(x, p(x))

ax1.set_title("CGPA vs Salary")
ax1.set_xlabel("CGPA")
ax1.set_ylabel("Salary")
ax1.grid()

# -------------------------------
# 2. Avg Salary vs Internships
# -------------------------------
ax2 = plt.subplot(2,3,2)

avg_salary = df.groupby('Internships')['Salary_LPA'].mean()

ax2.plot(avg_salary.index, avg_salary.values, marker='o')

ax2.set_title("Avg Salary vs Internships")
ax2.set_xlabel("Internships")
ax2.set_ylabel("Avg Salary")
ax2.grid()

# -------------------------------
# 3. Salary Distribution
# -------------------------------
ax3 = plt.subplot(2,3,3)

ax3.hist(df['Salary_LPA'])

ax3.set_title("Salary Distribution")
ax3.set_xlabel("Salary")
ax3.set_ylabel("Frequency")


# -------------------------------
# 4. Placement vs Salary (Box Plot) 
# -------------------------------
ax4 = plt.subplot(2,3,4)

# Create labels
df['Placement_Label'] = df['Placement_Status'].map({1: 'Placed', 0: 'Not Placed'})

# Boxplot
ax4.boxplot(
    [df[df['Placement_Label']=='Placed']['Salary_LPA'],
     df[df['Placement_Label']=='Not Placed']['Salary_LPA']],
    labels=['Placed', 'Not Placed']
)

ax4.set_title("Salary Distribution by Placement Status")
ax4.set_xlabel("Placement Status")
ax4.set_ylabel("Salary (LPA)")
ax4.grid(axis='y')

# 5. Avg Salary by College Tie
# -------------------------------
ax5 = plt.subplot(2,3,5)

tier_salary = df.groupby('College_Tier')['Salary_LPA'].mean()

ax5.bar(tier_salary.index, tier_salary.values)

ax5.set_title("Avg Salary by College Tier")
ax5.set_xlabel("College Tier")
ax5.set_ylabel("Salary")
ax5.grid(axis='y')

# -------------------------------
ax6 = plt.subplot(2,3,6)

spec_counts = df['Specialization'].value_counts()

plt.pie(spec_counts, labels=spec_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%')

plt.title("Specialization Distribution")

plt.show()

# -------------------------------
# FINAL SPACING (VERY IMPORTANT)
# -------------------------------
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])

plt.show()
